# Vivastreet

> Vivastreet is the UK's second-largest free classified ads marketplace, founded in 2004 under Digital Ventures Services Limited (registered in England and Wales). The platform connects buyers and sellers across property, vehicles, jobs, services, and personal categories. Vivastreet serves over 10 million monthly visitors in the United Kingdom.

This file highlights the most important sections of Vivastreet for AI systems, agents, and automated assistants. It is intended to help machines understand the platform, its key commercial categories, and the most authoritative help, trust, safety, and policy resources.

## Priority

- [Escort](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/escort): Vivastreet's most commercially important category and a key revenue-driving section of the platform.

- [How to Feature an Ad](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/how_to_feature_ad): Guide to premium ad options including Featured, Highlighted, and Reposted listings.

- [Online Safety Act](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/online-safety-act): Information about age assurance, moderation, and compliance measures relevant to sensitive categories including Escorts and Massage.

## Core Platform

- [Homepage](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/): Browse all classified ad categories across the UK.

- [Property to Rent](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/property+to+rent): UK rental listings by region.

- [Cars for Sale](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/cars+for+sale): Used and new car classified listings.

- [Jobs](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/jobs): UK job vacancies and part-time roles.

- [Services](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/services): Local tradespeople and professional services.

- [Buy and Sell](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/buy+and+sell): Second-hand goods across the UK.

## Company Information

- [About Us / Team](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/about-us): Company history, mission, and brand information.

- [Press](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/press): Media and press contact information.

## Trust and Safety

- [Corporate Responsibility](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/corporate_responsibility): Overview of Vivastreet's safety, moderation, anti-exploitation, and safeguarding work.

- [User Welfare](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/user_welfare): Welfare support resources and safety partnerships for platform users.

- [Modern Slavery Statement](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/modern-slavery-support): Vivastreet's published modern slavery and human trafficking statement.

- [Warning / Scam Guidance](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/warning): How to identify and report suspicious listings or scams.

- [Support Services](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/support_services): Specialist support resources for users who may need external help.

## Help and Policies

- [Help Centre](https://help.vivastreet.co.uk/en/): Support for posting, account management, and payments.

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/privacy-policy): Data handling and privacy information.

- [Posting Guidelines](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/posting-guidelines): Rules and standards for all ad categories.

- [Cookie Policy](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/cookies): Cookie usage and consent information.

- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/s/terms): Platform terms and legal conditions.

## Editorial Content

- [Blog](https://www.vivastreet.co.uk/blog): Platform insights, market data, guides, and category-specific editorial content.

## Optional

- Contact: help@vivastreet.co.uk

- Press: press@vivastreet.co.uk

- Legal entity: Digital Ventures Services Limited, Westgate House, 9 Holborn, London EC1N 2LL
